title: Walking bass: Bro and Johnny Lindsay
summary: He recalls a bassist who walked the bass at the Entertainers Cafe, and Johnny Lindsay's four-beat New Orleans bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well, the Barnes, I can't remember who else. Maybe, what's that bass player from New Orleans? John and Lindsey, I think. John. I think John and Lindsey was playing bass, because I don't think Bro was playing bass, because Bro was with us at the, uh, Entertainer's Cafe. Oh, yeah, Bro was the first one, when I, uh, we had some piece, and Bro was playing a, uh, walking bass, and that was the first time that, uh, I mean, the first night that Bro came on the job, and I was playing this violin, I heard all this bass, walking bass. I turned around, still playing, and I was looking at him, see, trying to figure out what he was doing. See? Because all the other bass, uh, we hadn't had a tuba before, you know, a tuba was playing boom, boom. See? And so, Bro was like boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom. He was walking the bass, and, and, and it sounds so good, and it gave such an impetus to us, you know, I mean, it gave such a feeling, a rhythm to the, to the music, that, uh, I turned around, still playing, and looked at him. So, when we had Iron the Mission, I said, what was, what was you playing on such and such a number? And so, Bro said, I was playing what I call walking bass. And so, uh, I said, well, the chord was E flat. I said, did you play E flat, G, B flat, and E flat? And he said, no, I put a C in there. Oh, I said, yeah, that belongs to the chord, and then I memorized it, see? So that, that, uh, that, uh, thinking back to Bro, uh, when I was talking about Johnny Lindsay playing, well, that Johnny Lindsay played that New Orleans style four beats. See, most all the other bass players ever played boom, boom, boom, boom. And so, uh, that's, I think, why I remember that Johnny Lindsay was with, uh,
Johnny Lindsay also played trombone. He didn't play trombone in the band.
